messages:
Aisha: Good morning team — quick handoff. I'm on until 16:00 UTC. High-level: Dedicated pool maintenance scheduled 02:00 UTC tonight (2026-04-12); we will drain nodes briefly. Blockers: none. Watch: small spike in KV cache evictions on cluster-east (~4%) over baseline.

Aisha: Action items: Ethan to monitor eviction rate and raise threshold if it hits 6% ; Kai to watch dedicated autoscale during drain; Maya to finish patch for routing policy PR #452.

Ethan: Thanks — noted. I'll set an alert to 6% and leave a sticky note in the console.

oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled: dedicated-maintenance/2026-04-12@02:00 UTC — draining nodes in cluster-east. Status: planned.

Kai: Can you paste the eviction query? I want to check logs path.

Aisha: logs path: /var/log/serving/kv_evictions.log
Quick grep: `grep -E "evict|eviction" /var/log/serving/kv_evictions.log | tail -n 30`

Maya: PR #452 is in review — minor lint flake. ETA for merge: today afternoon. If merged, routing policy fallback order changes (tier->latency->cost) — watch early canary.

Ethan: I'll spin a quick canary in us-west after merge, low-traffic route. Ping here when merged.

Aisha: FYI: Customer X has a private deployment cutover scheduled Friday; their support engineer will test with dedicated tokens. No actions unless they flag perf regressions.

Kai: During maintenance, autoscaler behaves weird if we have 0 desired replicas in pool — remember to set min_replicas=1 on the pool. I'll add a comment to the maintenance runbook.

Ethan: :thumbsup: I'll also add a temporary monitor dashboard with 1m resolution for token latency + queues.

Maya: If anyone sees canary > 200ms tail, rollback to v3.1.8 (reenable fallback).

Aisha: handoff notes pinned: https://redwood.example.com/handoffs/2026-04-12-late-morning
If anything urgent ping @oncall-escalation.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Night shift coverage rotation in 6h. Next oncall: Kai.

Kai: Copy. I'll pick up at 16:00 UTC. Leaving mobile + pager: +1-555-0123.

Ethan: One more: there is a flaky test failing in CI that sometimes increases queue times: test-routing-latency. If you see it, ignore transient test failures.

Aisha: Thanks all. No immediate action required — keep an eye on evictions and canary after PR merge. Signing off for now, will check later.
